theme.en: AI racks expose memory and packaging limits
theme.zh: AI机柜暴露存储与封装瓶颈

dek.en: Hot Chips disclosures put rack-scale AI designs in focus, while HBM thickness, foundry capacity and verification workflows show where the next constraints are forming.
dek.zh: Hot Chips披露将焦点转向机柜级AI设计；同时，HBM厚度、晶圆代工产能和验证流程显示出下一轮约束所在。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: AMD details MI400 GPU architecture for Helios racks
title.zh: AMD详解面向Helios机柜的MI400 GPU架构

summary.en: AMD used Hot Chips 2026 to outline the MI400 GPU architecture and how it fits into Helios rack systems. The presentation shifts attention from an individual accelerator to the system design needed to deploy a very large GPU at rack scale.
summary.zh: AMD在Hot Chips 2026上概述了MI400 GPU架构及其在Helios机柜系统中的部署方式。这场发布将关注点从单颗加速器转向在机柜尺度部署超大GPU所需的系统设计。

title.en: NVIDIA presents the Vera Rubin NVL72 rack
title.zh: NVIDIA展示Vera Rubin NVL72机柜

summary.en: NVIDIA detailed the Vera Rubin NVL72 rack at Hot Chips 2026 as part of its AI Factory design. The disclosure frames the product as a rack-level platform, underscoring that networking, memory and power integration are now central to accelerator delivery.
summary.zh: NVIDIA在Hot Chips 2026上介绍了作为AI Factory设计一部分的Vera Rubin NVL72机柜。该披露将产品定位为机柜级平台，凸显网络、存储与供电集成已成为交付加速器的核心环节。

title.en: Waymo explains its custom sensor-fusion processor
title.zh: Waymo介绍其定制传感器融合处理器

summary.en: Waymo used Hot Chips 2026 to discuss the custom processor it uses for sensor fusion in autonomous driving. It is a useful reminder that specialized silicon is spreading beyond data-center training and inference into latency-sensitive edge systems.
summary.zh: Waymo在Hot Chips 2026上介绍了其用于自动驾驶传感器融合的定制处理器。这表明专用芯片正从数据中心训练和推理扩展到对时延敏感的边缘系统。

title.en: Intel unveils Diamond Rapids Xeon with up to 256 P-cores
title.zh: Intel发布最高256个P核的Diamond Rapids Xeon

summary.en: Intel disclosed its next-generation Diamond Rapids Xeon at Hot Chips, with up to 256 P-cores, AVX 10.2 and UCIe-S in place of EMIB for the package. The 18A-P server CPU shows Intel leaning on chiplet interconnect choices as well as core count for its 2027 platform.
summary.zh: Intel在Hot Chips上披露了下一代Diamond Rapids Xeon：最高256个P核，支持AVX 10.2，并以UCIe-S取代EMIB用于封装互连。这颗18A-P服务器CPU显示，Intel的2027平台除增加核心数外，也在依靠Chiplet互连方案。

title.en: Avestra applies agentic AI to SystemVerilog assertions
title.zh: Avestra将智能体AI用于SystemVerilog断言生成

summary.en: Avestra is presented as an agentic-AI approach to generating SystemVerilog Assertions, which encode temporal design intent for ASIC and SoC verification. If it reduces assertion-authoring effort without weakening review, it could target a persistent pre-tapeout verification bottleneck.
summary.zh: Avestra被介绍为一种利用智能体AI生成SystemVerilog Assertions的方法；这类断言为ASIC和SoC验证编码跨时钟周期的设计意图。若能在不削弱审查的前提下减少断言编写工作，它将瞄准流片前长期存在的验证瓶颈。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Broadcom AI-chip sales rise as Samsung seeks foundry openings
title.zh: Broadcom AI芯片销售增长，Samsung寻求代工机会

summary.en: Chosunbiz reports that Broadcom doubled AI-chip sales while a TSMC bottleneck creates an opening for Samsung Foundry. The combination links rising custom-silicon demand to a practical question for customers: whether qualified leading-edge capacity can be sourced beyond TSMC.
summary.zh: Chosunbiz报道称，Broadcom的AI芯片销售翻倍，而TSMC的瓶颈为Samsung Foundry创造了机会。这一组合将定制芯片需求增长与一个现实问题联系起来：客户能否在TSMC以外获得经过验证的先进制程产能。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: SK hynix puts hybrid bonding on the HBM5 path
title.zh: SK hynix将混合键合纳入HBM5路线

summary.en: SK hynix said hybrid bonding will not be ready for HBM4E and instead targets HBM5, while extending MR-MUF through NVIDIA Rubin. The company identifies a 775-micron total HBM-stack thickness ceiling, making packaging process maturity a constraint on further stacking.
summary.zh: SK hynix表示混合键合尚不能用于HBM4E，将目标放在HBM5，并将MR-MUF延续至NVIDIA Rubin平台。公司指出HBM堆叠总厚度受限于775微米，这使封装工艺成熟度成为继续增加堆叠层数的约束。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Taiwan charges nine in alleged AI-server export case
title.zh: 台湾就涉嫌AI服务器出口案起诉九人

summary.en: Taiwan charged nine people over alleged illegal exports of AI servers to China; the report says NVIDIA and Super Micro employees are among those involved. The case illustrates how enforcement increasingly reaches server integration and shipment routes, not only the chip sale itself.
summary.zh: 台湾就涉嫌向中国非法出口AI服务器一案起诉九人；报道称涉案者包括NVIDIA和Super Micro员工。该案显示，执法范围正延伸至服务器集成和运输路径，而不仅是芯片销售本身。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 财报与市场

title.en: AMD narrows Intel's adjusted server-CPU share gap
title.zh: AMD缩小与Intel调整后服务器CPU份额差距

summary.en: Mercury Research data cited by Wccftech put AMD at an adjusted 46.4% of the server-CPU market versus Intel's 53.6%. The report also says Intel data-center revenue rose 59% year on year, showing that revenue momentum and unit-share momentum can diverge.
summary.zh: Wccftech援引Mercury Research的数据称，AMD在调整后的服务器CPU市场占46.4%，Intel为53.6%。报道还称Intel数据中心收入同比增长59%，说明营收动能与出货份额动能可能出现背离。

title.en: Challengers
title.zh: 挑战者

title.en: NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX enters full production
title.zh: NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX进入全面量产

summary.en: StorageReview reports that NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX has entered full production, with a claimed 3,400 tokens per second at 100K context and 256 LP30s per rack. The figures put the emphasis on long-context inference throughput and rack density, two measures that matter as agentic workloads scale.
summary.zh: StorageReview报道称，NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX已进入全面量产，宣称在100K上下文下达到每秒3,400个token，并可在每个机柜部署256个LP30。该指标把重点放在长上下文推理吞吐量和机柜密度上，二者均是智能体工作负载扩展时的重要衡量标准。

theme.en: Wide-bandgap devices confront interfaces and models
theme.zh: 宽禁带器件直面界面与模型难题

dek.en: This week's selection centers on SiC, GaN, diamond and two-dimensional heterostructures, where thermal gains and high-field performance depend on interface control and credible device models.
dek.zh: 本周论文聚焦SiC、GaN、金刚石及二维异质结构：其散热收益和高场性能取决于界面控制与可信的器件模型。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Comparing inhomogeneous Schottky-barrier models in SiC polytypes
title.zh: SiC多型中非均匀肖特基势垒模型的比较

papers.authors: Fayssal Mekaret, A. Rabehi, B. Zebentout, et al.

summary.en: The authors compare Cowley–Sze, Werner Gaussian-distribution and Tung localized-patch descriptions of Schottky-barrier inhomogeneity in 3C-, 4H- and 6H-SiC. The analysis separates interface-state pinning, statistical barrier variation and localized low-barrier current paths, helping modelers choose a mechanism rather than treating nonideal I–V behavior as a single effect.
summary.zh: 作者比较了Cowley–Sze、Werner高斯分布和Tung局域斑块三种模型，用于描述3C、4H和6H-SiC中的肖特基势垒非均匀性。该分析区分了界面态钉扎、势垒统计波动和低势垒局域电流路径，有助于建模者避免将非理想I–V特性归为单一效应。

title.en: Diamond heat spreaders can electrostatically alter GaN FETs
title.zh: 金刚石散热层可通过静电效应改变GaN FET性能

papers.authors: Lincoln D. Hogan, MD Mazharul Islam, A. Aziz

summary.en: TCAD simulations of AlGaN/GaN HEMTs with integrated diamond heat spreaders reproduce the expected thermal benefit but reveal a countervailing electrostatic effect at the diamond/GaN interface. Band bending and interfacial hole accumulation can alter vertical transport and suppress on-state current, so thermal integration cannot be designed independently of electrostatics.
summary.zh: 针对集成金刚石散热层的AlGaN/GaN HEMT的TCAD仿真重现了预期的散热收益，却发现了金刚石/GaN界面的相反静电效应。能带弯曲和界面空穴积累会改变垂直输运并抑制导通电流，因此散热集成不能脱离静电设计而单独优化。

title.en: Diamond power devices: progress and barriers in harsh environments
title.zh: 金刚石功率器件在严苛环境中的进展与障碍

papers.authors: Nuwayyir Alshammari, M. V. Rao, Qiliang Li

summary.en: This review maps progress in diamond growth, substrates, surface control, dielectrics and device structures for ultrawide-bandgap electronics. It finds the strongest high-voltage evidence in diodes, while transistors remain constrained by threshold control, normally-off operation, contacts, interfaces and reliability.
summary.zh: 该综述梳理了面向超宽禁带电子学的金刚石生长、衬底、表面控制、介质和器件结构进展。文中认为二极管在高压能力方面证据最充分，而晶体管仍受阈值控制、常关特性、接触、界面和可靠性限制。

title.en: GaN/TMD heterojunctions span high-frequency and sensing devices
title.zh: GaN/TMD异质结覆盖高频与传感器件

papers.authors: Guoxin Li, Lipeng Luo, Qian Zhang, et al.

summary.en: The review surveys GaN and transition-metal dichalcogenide heterojunctions for electronics, optoelectronics, sensing and energy conversion. It identifies interface engineering, material synthesis and large-area integration as the common obstacles between attractive device demonstrations and practical deployment.
summary.zh: 该综述考察GaN与过渡金属硫族化物异质结在电子、光电子、传感和能量转换中的应用。文中指出，界面工程、材料合成和大面积集成是从有吸引力的器件演示走向实际部署的共同障碍。

title.en: Graphene MOS-HEMT study explores a two-dimensional power device
title.zh: 石墨烯MOS-HEMT研究探索二维功率器件

summary.en: Using Silvaco ATLAS simulations, this work models a graphene-channel MOS-HEMT with graphene oxide as the gate dielectric. At a reported 1 V threshold it obtains 1,280 mA drain current, about twice the cited GaN comparison, but the result remains a simulation-led device proposal rather than measured hardware.
summary.zh: 该工作使用Silvaco ATLAS仿真，以石墨烯为沟道、氧化石墨烯为栅介质构建MOS-HEMT。在报告的1 V阈值下，漏电流达到1,280 mA，约为所引用GaN对照的两倍；但该结果仍是以仿真为主的器件方案，而非实测硬件。

title.en: Circuits & Reliability
title.zh: 电路与可靠性

title.en: Electrothermal SPICE modeling for 650 V GaN power conversion
title.zh: 面向650 V GaN功率转换的电热SPICE建模

papers.authors: Mohamed Foued Guellati, Z. Riah, Y. Azzouz, M. Tlig

summary.en: The paper calibrates an electrothermal model of a commercial 650 V GaN HEMT against static I–V and dynamic C–V data, then optimizes it with an LTspice and genetic-algorithm flow. It reports mean absolute relative errors below 7% for forward I–V and 13% for reverse I–V from 25–100 °C, directly addressing the models needed for EMI and EMC design.
summary.zh: 论文以静态I–V和动态C–V数据校准商用650 V GaN HEMT的电热模型，再通过LTspice与遗传算法流程进行优化。其报告在25–100 °C范围内正向I–V平均相对误差低于7%、反向I–V低于13%，直接服务于EMI和EMC设计所需的可信模型。
